name: Concurrent Enrollment for High School Students at Diablo Valley College
what_you_do: Take DVC classes on your own while you are still in high school. You earn college credit. The page has a list of high school friendly classes.
who_can_apply: High school students, including home-schooled students. You need a Special Admissions Recommendation Form each term. You, a parent, and your principal or their designee must sign it. Students on an F-1 international visa cannot be in high school and DVC at the same time.
pay_detail: California high school students pay no tuition. You pay student union fees and the cost of class materials.
deadline_text: You submit the form every term. This page does not list dates.
how_to_apply: Apply to DVC. After you are accepted, submit the Special Admissions Recommendation Form in the student portal. List the classes you want. Then check prerequisites and sign up for classes.
notes: A signed form with no classes listed is not accepted. You can only sign up for the classes listed on the form. If you use a school district program such as dual enrollment, follow that program instead. Not sure which one to use? Ask your counselor.
